messages:
Elaine (Product PM): Quick sync — want to lock down the small-wave post-launch plan for ACME. Short thread: which items must go in the hotfix vs next minor?
Marco (Engineering Lead): +1. From infra view we should land the P0 crash fix and the token-dup regression in the hotfix. The analytics UI tweak can wait one minor.
Jen (CS): Customer asks to bundle the back-button behavior and the analytics event fix together. They said back-button is high-friction for onboarding flow.
Saanvi (QA): If we do crash + token fix in hotfix I need a 24h smoke + canary run window. Can we freeze other changes for that patch?
Rahul (Backend Eng): Freeze is fine. For prioritization: P0 crash (root cause: race in session GC), P1 token-dup (KV cache mis-index), then analytics event rename (P2). Hotfix timeline if we push: patch branch today, internal review tomorrow, canary + QA Wed.
Elaine (Product PM): Proposed split: HOTFIX = [P0 crash, P1 token-dup, small analytics event rename if it doesn't touch DB schemas]. NEXT MINOR = [UI back-button UX polish, enhanced rollout flags, docs]. Anyone strongly opposed?
Marco (Engineering Lead): Sounds good. Flag: if analytics rename touches event-T schema we'll move to next minor.
Jen (CS): Customer prefers back-button in hotfix but understands risk. If it stays in next minor pls communicate timeline + workaround (keyboard shortcut).
Saanvi (QA): QA checklist for hotfix (short):
```
- Full regression on login/onboarding happy path
- Canaries in eu-west1 + us-east1 for 6h
- Sanity metrics check (error-rate, p99 latency)
- Verify no DB migrations in hotfix artifacts
```
Rahul (Backend Eng): I'll draft the hotfix PR + include the safety toggles. Also adding a small telemetry flag to measure success (no schema change).
Elaine (Product PM): Launch criteria for hotfix (must pass all):
- P0 fix deployed to canary and validated by QA
- p99 latency not degraded >10%
- Error rate <= baseline + 0.5% for 24h
- Customer sign-off on included changes
If any of these fail, rollback and re-evaluate.
Marco (Engineering Lead): Ops note: reserve capacity for canary (two extra instances) — tagging infra for allocation.
ops-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2025-11-18T04:00:00Z (scheduled by ops-bot).
Jen (CS): I'll prep the customer comms draft and include the workaround.
Saanvi (QA): I'll schedule the canary verification slot and add the checklist to the runbook.
Elaine (Product PM): Cool — owners: Rahul (engineering lead for patch), Saanvi (QA verification), Jen (customer comms). We'll reconvene after canary validation. :thumbsup:
Marco (Engineering Lead): One more ask — include a quick postmortem blurb in the release notes so customers see remediation steps.
Elaine (Product PM): Agreed. I'll add postmortem blurb and timeline in the release notes draft.
ops-bot: Reminder: don't forget to update the incident tag if new customer impact observed.
Rahul (Backend Eng): Starting the PR now, tagging @Marco for review.
Jen (CS): Thanks all — looping customer in once we have canary green. :rocket:
